title: Simple Machines
description: Grade 5 Science: simple machines — levers, inclined planes, wedges, pulleys and wheels. How machines make work easier, with a label-the-lever game and experiments.

topics.title: Machines Make Work Easier
topics.concept:
A machine is a tool that helps us do work with less effort. A simple machine has few or no moving parts but is wonderfully useful.

  • 💪 Machines do not make new energy — they just make work easier.
  • 🪜 They help us lift, move, cut, push or pull.
  • ⚙️ The main simple machines are the lever, inclined plane, wedge, screw, pulley and wheel-and-axle.

recap: A machine helps us do work with less effort.
Simple machines have few or no moving parts.
They do not make new energy — they make work easier.

wonder.text: Lifting a heavy box straight up is hard. But push it up a ramp and it feels easier. How can a simple machine help?

qa.q: Does a machine give us extra strength?
qa.a: Not exactly — a machine does not make new energy. It just lets us use our effort in a smarter way, so a job that was hard becomes easier.
Yes! A knife is a simple machine called a wedge. Its thin, sharp edge helps us cut and split things easily — much harder to do without it.

topics.title: Levers
topics.concept:
A lever is a stiff bar that turns on a fixed point. It has three important parts:

  • 📍 Fulcrum — the fixed point the lever turns on.
  • 📦 Load — the heavy thing we want to move.
  • 💪 Effort — the push or pull we put in.

A see-saw, a crowbar, scissors and a bottle opener are all levers. They let us lift heavy loads with less effort.

recap: A lever is a stiff bar that turns on a fixed point.
See-saws, scissors and crowbars are levers.

wonder.text: A see-saw, a bottle opener and scissors all share a hidden secret. They are all the same simple machine. Which one?

qa.q: What is the fulcrum on a see-saw?
qa.a: The fulcrum is the bar in the middle that the see-saw balances and turns on. The children on each end are the loads and the efforts going up and down!

qa.q: How does a lever lift a heavy load easily?
qa.a: By pushing down on the long end (effort), the short end lifts the heavy load. The lever lets a small push move a big weight — clever!

topics.title: The Inclined Plane and Wedge
topics.concept:
Two more simple machines use slopes:

  • 🛝 An inclined plane is a slope or ramp. Pushing a load up a ramp is easier than lifting it straight up. Stairs and slides are inclined planes.
  • 🪓 A wedge is like two slopes back-to-back, ending in a sharp edge. It is used to cut or split things — an axe, a knife and a needle are wedges.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 300 160" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="300" height="160" fill="#fff7ea"/><polygon points="20,130 140,130 20,70" fill="#ffe1a8" stroke="#e0a800" stroke-width="2"/><text x="80" y="150" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#b26a00" text-anchor="middle">Inclined plane</text><g transform="translate(195,30)"><rect x="20" y="0" width="8" height="60" rx="3" fill="#a4724a"/><polygon points="10,60 38,60 24,104" fill="#cfd3da" stroke="#8a8f98" stroke-width="2"/></g><text x="219" y="150" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#7a5b3a" text-anchor="middle">Wedge (axe)</text></svg>
recap: An inclined plane is a slope or ramp; it makes lifting easier.
Stairs and slides are inclined planes.
A wedge is a sharp double-slope used to cut or split (axe, knife).

wonder.text: Builders push heavy loads up a slope instead of lifting them straight up. Why is the slope easier?

qa.q: Why is pushing up a ramp easier than lifting?
qa.a: A ramp spreads the work over a longer, gentle distance, so you need less force at any moment. It takes longer, but it feels much easier!

qa.q: How does an axe split wood?
qa.a: An axe is a wedge. Its thin sharp edge pushes into the wood and forces it apart as you swing — turning a downward chop into a sideways split.

topics.title: Pulleys and Wheels
topics.concept:
Two simple machines use round parts:

  • 🎏 A pulley is a wheel with a rope over it. Pulling the rope DOWN lifts a load UP. It is used to raise flags, buckets from a well, and heavy loads on cranes.
  • 🛞 A wheel-and-axle is a wheel joined to a rod (axle). It helps things roll and move heavy loads easily — used in carts, cars and door handles.
topics.visual: <svg viewBox="0 0 300 170" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect width="300" height="170" fill="#f4fbff"/><g transform="translate(20,0)"><circle cx="60" cy="36" r="18" fill="#ffd24d" stroke="#e0a800" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="60" cy="36" r="4" fill="#8a6a10"/><path d="M44 36 v66 M76 36 v52" stroke="#8a8f98" stroke-width="3" fill="none"/><rect x="64" y="88" width="26" height="22" rx="3" fill="#7d8590"/><text x="60" y="150" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#1f7fe0" text-anchor="middle">Pulley</text></g><g transform="translate(180,0)"><circle cx="50" cy="80" r="34" fill="#cfe0ff" stroke="#5aa0e0" stroke-width="3"/><circle cx="50" cy="80" r="8" fill="#5aa0e0"/><rect x="50" y="76" width="50" height="8" rx="3" fill="#a4724a"/><text x="60" y="150" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#1f7fe0" text-anchor="middle">Wheel & axle</text></g></svg>
recap: A pulley is a wheel with a rope; pull down to lift up.
A wheel-and-axle helps things roll and move heavy loads.
Pulleys raise flags and buckets; wheels move carts.

wonder.text: How does a flag go all the way up a tall pole when you pull a rope downward?

qa.a: A pulley lets you pull DOWN (which is easy, with gravity helping) to lift something UP. It also lets you lift loads to high places you could not reach.

qa.q: Why do wheels make moving easier?
qa.a: Wheels roll, which has far less friction than dragging. So a heavy cart on wheels moves with much less effort than sliding it along the ground.

topics.title: Machines All Around Us
topics.concept:
Simple machines are everywhere, often hidden inside the things we use:

  • ✂️ Scissors = two levers + two wedges (blades).
  • 🪜 Stairs and ramps = inclined planes.
  • 🚪 A door handle = a wheel-and-axle.
  • 🔩 A screw = a slope wrapped around a rod.

When two or more simple machines work together, they make a complex machine, like a bicycle or a crane.

recap: Simple machines are hidden in everyday tools.
Scissors are levers + wedges; a door handle is a wheel-and-axle.
Two or more simple machines together make a complex machine.

wonder.text: From your scissors to the staircase to the door handle — how many simple machines have you used today?

qa.a: Scissors join two simple machines! The handles and pivot make them levers, and the sharp blades are wedges. Together they cut paper with ease.
A complex machine is made of two or more simple machines working together. A bicycle uses wheels, levers (pedals and brakes) and more — all teaming up!

questions.explanation: A machine makes work easier; it does not make new energy.

questions.q: The point a lever turns on is the…
questions.explanation: The fulcrum is the fixed point a lever turns on.

questions.q: A ramp is an example of a…
questions.explanation: A ramp is an inclined plane.

questions.q: Which machine helps raise a flag up a pole?
questions.explanation: A pulley lets us pull down to lift the flag up.

questions.q: An axe is which simple machine?
questions.explanation: An axe is a wedge — its sharp edge splits things.
A see-saw is a lever that turns on a central fulcrum.

questions.q: Why is pushing a box up a ramp easier than lifting it straight up?
options: The work is spread over a longer, gentle distance so less force is needed
questions.explanation: A ramp spreads the effort over a longer distance, so less force is needed at a time.

questions.q: How does moving a lever's fulcrum closer to the load help?
options: It makes the load easier to lift
questions.explanation: With the fulcrum closer to the load, a smaller effort can lift it.

questions.q: Why do wheels make moving a heavy cart easier?
options: Rolling has much less friction than dragging
questions.explanation: Rolling on wheels has far less friction than dragging a load.

questions.q: Scissors are a clever tool because they combine…
questions.explanation: Scissors are levers (handles + pivot) with wedge-shaped blades.

questions.q: Two or more simple machines working together make a…
questions.explanation: Combined simple machines make a complex machine, like a bicycle.
